bullets: Ultralight & Portable: Weighing only 85 grams (3 oz), this stove is lightweight. Its compact design fits neatly into your backpack, making it ideal for hiking, trekking, fishing, hunting, and emergency use.
Durable Premium Materials: Built with stainless steel, ceramic, aluminum alloy, and silicone, this stove offers long-lasting durability and reliable performance for outdoor adventures.
Fuel-Efficient Design: Designed for power and efficiency, it maximizes fuel usage, allowing you to cook more with less fuel—an economical choice for your outdoor needs.
Versatile Outdoor Gear: Suitable for camping, hiking, trekking, fishing, and hunting, this portable stove is an essential, reliable tool for any outdoor enthusiast.
Folds down to just 2.1 x 2.8 inches, saving space and making it easy to carry anywhere. Pair it with G3 pot for a better user experience.
Please note: Greenpeak 1 is not compatible with the Z1 adapter.
